title: Desktop shows four KPI tiles in a row and two count tiles below
pre_body:
Preconditions

  1. User: you are signed in as an Admin (the Admin role has every permission, including Reports).
  2. Location: you are in one location (workplace).
  3. Browser: you use a desktop browser at 100% zoom on a screen at least 1280 pixels wide (e.g. a 1920 x 1080 monitor).
